 * `CATALOG_PATHS` (home, the three filter states, trash and junk files), rebuilds the catalog filters from the address

 * fetching (`ShellActions.catalog`).
 *
 * The element is keyed by page: home, the three filter states and the trash draw the same grid and share
 * one element; junk files are a separate page. Works with no backdrop and queue addresses (deep links,
 * refresh) also mount on this element. Changing filters, back/forward and a shell-requested reopen do not
 * re-mount; after each round of changes the element decides, in a microtask, which of the following to do,
 * in order:
 * - Details is stacked on top: if the entry recorded a backdrop (the page group matches on the backdrop) it
 *   does nothing and the page below keeps drawing; with no backdrop it fills in the catalog grid once
 *   (`ShellActions.catalog.fill`), leaving no skeleton forever loading beneath the details.
 * - The shell asks for a full reopen from the current address (`pageOpens` increments: startup, a deep-linked
 *   details closed and the page it came from filled back in, entering the trash from the admin bar): open the
 *   whole page.
 * - It receives a new page-open sequence number (back/forward, navigation the shell did not claim): open the
 *   whole page; on history navigation it reuses the filters and seed the entry saved, and rebuilds from the
 *   address when nothing is recorded. If the address carries `seed`, that is used.
 * - The shell claimed the written address (filter change, sort change, next batch, back to home): the shell
 *   already wrote the filters into `state`, so only refetch; when closing the details returns to the address
 *   it was covering and the filters did not change, do not refetch. If this page has never been opened (a
 *   back landing on details stacked over something else, so it was covered at mount time), open the whole
 *   page.
 * When `pageOpens` is still 0 the shell has not started routing and the element just sits mounted. At the
 * moment of mounting, depending on whether that history change was claimed, it counts as one of the latter
 * two; if the route root is mounted only after the shell has started routing, the moment of mounting counts
 * as the first kind.
 *
 * When `?state=ads` lands on home it does not open there; it is rewritten to the junk-files address (no entry
 * added) and the junk files page's element opens it from there. The target page immediately shows a waiting
 * state for the changing area; stable controls are not re-mounted. The decisions and rewrites run in a
 * microtask, avoiding the route root's commit phase. */

u: /** 署名里的名字：人像字形加名字。外层元素（`data-media-who` 的按钮、链接或纯文本）归调用方。 */
en: The name in the attribution: a portrait glyph plus the name. The outer element (the data-media-who button, link, or plain text) belongs to the caller.

u: /* 卡片／列表与馆藏同一个开关（`peach.catalog-view.v1`）：JAV 页的馆藏与新作一起切。 */
en: Card / list uses the same toggle as the library (peach.catalog-view.v1): the JAV page's library and new releases switch together.

u: /** 浏览记录怎么来.已经采集到记录、或Skip之后都不再出现，`?onboarding=1` 进来时直接展开. */
en: How browsing records arrive. Once a record has been collected, or after Skip, it no longer appears; when coming in with ?onboarding=1, it expands directly.

u: /* JAV 想要: 按状态分组的作品卡，复用Resource links查询与Find resources弹层. */
en: JAV wanted: work cards grouped by status, reusing the Resource links query and the Find resources popover.

u: /* 骨架淡出那一拍与真卡同在页面上，所以不带 `id` 与测试认卡用的 `data-*`，只留决定样式的标记。 */
en: In the beat where the skeleton fades out, it's on the page with the real card, so it carries no id or data-* used for test card recognition; only the markers that determine styling remain.

u: /* 没数据的查询重取时 Query 把状态退回 pending，失败后的轮询看着和首取一样；失败过的不算首取。 */
en: When a no-data query refetches, Query reverts the status to pending; polling after failure looks like the first fetch; a failed one doesn't count as the first fetch.

u: /** `inset`：进度条贴着视口边时（沉浸），预览离两端留的距离；Video.js 的进度条本身已经内缩。 */
en: inset: the distance the preview keeps from both ends when the progress bar is flush against the viewport edge (immersive); Video.js's progress bar is already inset on its own.

u: /** 署名行末尾的日期：日历字形加日期，收在 `data-media-facts` 里，窄卡上随它换到下一行。 */
en: The date at the end of the attribution line: a calendar glyph plus the date, kept inside data-media-facts; on a narrow card it wraps to the next line with it.

u: /** `down` 正按着；`slot` 还空着的位置；`invalid` 这一下没过；`done` 刚录好。 */
en: down is being pressed; slot is a still-empty position; invalid this one didn't pass; done was just recorded.

u: /** 点这张卡Open什么.竖屏带点进沉浸模式，Trash里的Resources按类型分流，其余Open详情. */
en: What clicking this card Opens. Portrait with a dot enters immersive mode, Resources in the Trash route by type, the rest Open detail.

u: /** 一条Lookup results.候选逐条列，已经Follows的列出来但不许再勾——否则人以为没查到. */
en: A Lookup result. Candidates are listed one by one; ones already Followed are listed but not allowed to be checked again — otherwise the person thinks nothing was found.

u: /** 新作分区的排序：发行时间打头（默认），其余同「发现」；`random` 是「换一批」，没有对应的排序键。 */
en: The sort of the new-releases section: release time first (default), the rest same as 'Discover'; random is 'new batch', with no corresponding sort key.

u: /** 等页面闲下来再做；返回撤销函数。不支持 `requestIdleCallback` 的浏览器退回定时器。 */
en: Do it after the page idles; returns an undo function. Browsers without requestIdleCallback fall back to a timer.

u: /* 「Add media library」New一组，名称、图标、Source color与处理方式都单独设. */
en: 'Add media library' creates a New group; the name, icon, Source color, and handling method are each set separately.

u: /** 只预热 Peach 自有接触印相：页数可数。外部来源的 `s` 是帧号、一帧一图，可能几百张，按需取。 */
en: Only preheat Peach's own touch frames: the page count is countable. External sources' s is a frame number, one image per frame, possibly hundreds, fetched on demand.

u: /** 接着看那一排的推荐理由（`variant="next"`）：顶替标签行，和作品详情的接着看同一个写法。 */
en: The recommendation reason for the continue-watching row (variant="next"): replaces the tag row, the same as the continue-watching in the work detail.

u: // 满圈 3023 × 1.1，最小弧长是它的 2%：66.506，比欧美剧情的 36 大，那一段画的是垫高的弧。
en: // Full circle 3023 × 1.1, the minimum arc length is 2% of it: 66.506, larger than the 36 for Western dramas, so that segment draws a raised arc.

u: '作品详情身份区：各组按内容宽并排换行，名字在头像下居中、行框容得下下伸部；系列是整行宽的图标链接，不是标签胶囊'
en: 'Work detail identity area: each group wraps side by side by content width, the name is centered under the avatar with the row box fitting the descenders; the series is a full-row-width icon link, not a label pill'

u: `最新作 ${found.code || '无番号'} · ${day(found.release_date)}`
en: `Latest release ${found.code || 'No code'} · ${day(found.release_date)}`

u: 账本保存全部资料、观看记录与复核结论。手动备份与写入前的自动备份放在一起，保留最近 5 份和 24 小时内的备份。
en: The ledger stores all resources, watch records, and review conclusions. Manual backups and pre-write automatic backups are kept together, retaining the most recent 5 and backups within 24 hours.

en: // Check frame by frame whether home-page residue shows up: the home page title, and the shimmer of the image-waiting state that set visibility:visible on itself.

u: /** 接着看里的一叠能不能悬停翻卡：和关注列表同一个判据（多选、遮挡、减少动效、滚动中都回 false）。 */
en: Whether a stack in the continue-watching list can flip on hover: the same criterion as the following list (multi-select, occlusion, reduced motion, and scrolling all return false).

u: /* Accent color那一排同样不带颜色: 球拿的就是这一档真会写上去的 400 与 600 两级. */
en: The Accent color row is likewise colorless: the ball takes exactly the 400 and 600 levels this tier would actually write.

u: /* 「已归档」那句只给刚点了归档的人看，带着撤销；刷新后服务端只剩 `archived`，整块都不再出现。 */
en: The 'Archived' line is shown only to someone who just tapped archive, with an undo; after refresh the server only has archived, so the whole block no longer appears.

u: /** 「换一批」那枚图标的描线一圈，同 `search.css` 里的 `--strand-cycle`。 */
en: The single outline stroke of the 'new batch' icon, same as --strand-cycle in search.css.

u: /** 录制中正按着的键：只按了修饰键时 `code` 为 null；按了不能用的主键会留在这里，配着原因。 */
en: The key being held during recording: when only a modifier is pressed, code is null; an unusable main key stays here, with a reason.

u: /** 设备名是「浏览器 · 系统」：浏览器名前放浏览器标志，系统词前放平台标志；认不出的词照原文、不配图。 */
en: The device name is 'Browser · System': a browser mark before the browser name, a platform mark before the system word; unrecognized words stay as-is, no icon.

u: // 「New media library」把这个Folders拆成新的一组，焦点交给新组的名称框，接着就能起名.
en: 'New media library' splits this Folders into a new group, moves focus to the new group's name box, and you can then name it.

u: // 拿掉 `ResizeObserver` 让 Recharts 按初始尺寸画；声明减少动态效果，圈直接是终态。
en: Remove ResizeObserver so Recharts draws at its initial size; declare reduced motion, and the ring goes straight to its final state.

en: `${state.stage} · ${state.done || 0} / ${state.total} items`

en: `This trip has ${(state.issue_count || 0).toLocaleString()} issues.`

u: /** 同一标签页再次进入栏目，沿用最后一次的地址；已在该栏目时保持当前视图，搜索结果回到不带词的那一屏。 */
en: Re-entering a section in the same tab reuses the last address; if already in that section, keep the current view, and search results return to the screen without the term.

u: // 旧地址 /resource-sync 打开后转到资源同步二级页，占位先画成那一页，转过去时同一个键不重画。
en: // The old address /resource-sync, once opened, routes to the resource-sync second-level page; the placeholder is first drawn as that page, and when transitioning, the same key isn't redrawn.

u: /* 问题详情、错误详情、任务明细、技术详情都是可展开的明细，同样排成卡片底部带分隔线的一行，按这个顺序。 */
en: Issue details, error details, task details, and technical details are all expandable details, likewise laid out as a row at the card's bottom with a divider, in this order.

u: /* 比的是详情那一份全部标签：卡片上的内容标签只收来源分过类的 general，没分类的帖子一枚都没有。 */
en: Compared is the full tag set from the detail copy: the content tags on the card only take the general ones the source classified; uncategorized posts have none.

u: /* 来源那一格要放下站标、`video.dmm.co.jp` 与外链图标，160 会把站名压到图标底下。 */
en: The source cell needs to fit the site mark, video.dmm.co.jp, and the external-link icon; 160 would push the site name under the icon.

u: /** 行尾的Enabled开关: 只写这一条，不动勾选、不弹批量那句 toast，和订阅源表的开关一样. */
en: The Enabled toggle at the row's end: only writes this one, doesn't touch the checkbox, doesn't pop the batch toast, same as the subscription source table's toggle.

u: /* 页头的 `IndexSearch` 停手 300 毫秒才交出文字，这里换了就回第 1 页重问服务端。 */
en: The page header's IndexSearch waits 300 ms of idle before emitting text; here when it changes, return to page 1 and ask the server again.

u: /* 还没读过来源资料的那几部由服务端起一轮读取：跑着就按它给的间隔轮询，跑完再取一次，标签与筛选项补全。 */
en: The few not yet read from the source are kicked off by a server-side read round: while running, poll at its given interval, fetch once more when done, and tags and filter options are completed.

u: /** SFW 开关键，存本机不同步；传 null 恢复默认。改完壳调 `store.notify()`。 */
en: The SFW toggle key, stored locally, not synced; pass null to restore the default. After changing, the shell calls store.notify().

u: /** 表格使用横向拖动；滚轮维持浏览器行为，控件、列宽手柄与整行表头独立处理指针（表头按偏了也不起拖）。 */
en: The table uses horizontal dragging; the wheel keeps browser behavior; controls, column-width handles, and the whole header row handle the pointer independently (even a mis-pressed header doesn't start a drag).

u:
/* 行首图标和标签同在一个 flex 容器里；浏览器标志是素材图，平台标志是字形，都在标签

内。 */
en: The leading icon and the label sit in the same flex container; the browser mark is an asset image, the platform mark is a glyph, both inside the label's p.

u: `${data?.total || 0} / ${data?.candidate_total || 0} 部`
en: `${data?.total || 0} / ${data?.candidate_total || 0} works`

u: /** Board UI `Input` 中号的静止态：可带块级标签，框里是占位字或一截等数据的占位条。 */
en: The Board UI Input medium size in its resting state: can carry a block-level label; the box shows placeholder text or a data-waiting placeholder bar.

u: /** 这一轮只处理一部作品时，摘要里带它的 `asset_id` 与文件名，任务卡据此链接到作品详情。 */
en: When this round processes only one work, the summary carries its asset_id and filename, and the task card links to the work's detail based on this.

u: /** 能在页面里下载并Restart to install；只有 Windows 独立包是 true。 */
en: Can be downloaded and Restart to install within the page; only the Windows standalone package is true.

u: /** 输入框的占位字换一句，带动效（`rollPlaceholder`）；返回撤销函数。缺省时直接改。 */
en: Swap the input box's placeholder text to another phrase, with animation (rollPlaceholder); returns an undo function. When omitted, changes directly.

u: /** 保存会重启 Peach。扫描与采集在跑时先确认；读不到任务状态就照常保存，不让旁路读数挡住保存。 */
en: Saving restarts Peach. When a scan and collection are running, confirm first; if the task status can't be read, save as usual — don't let a side reading block saving.

u: /* 数据管理二级页的卡片标题与页头同名；只认页头那一层 h2，React 卡片何时挂载都只匹配一个。 */
en: The data management second-level page's card title shares the page header's name; only the page header's h2 is recognized, so whenever the React card mounts, only one matches.

u: // SFW 开关键（默认 Shift+S，可在设置里改）：有人走近时不必先打开设置（同 javm 的老板键
en: // SFW toggle key (default Shift+S, changeable in settings): when someone approaches, no need to open settings first (like javm's boss key

u: /** 存在本机，不随设置同步：⌘ 在 Windows 上是 Win 键，同一个绑定换台设备就不成立。 */
en: Stored locally, not synced with settings: ⌘ is the Win key on Windows, so the same binding doesn't hold on another device.

u: /** Ctrl（Mac 上是 ⌘）加这几个键是浏览器自己的新建、关闭、退出窗口，页面收不到这次按键。 */
en: Ctrl (⌘ on Mac) plus these keys are the browser's own new/close/quit window; the page doesn't receive this keypress.

u: /** `via` 只出现在未取得的网络读数上：`cloud` 是从网盘挂载读的，网速无法按任务计量。 */
en: via only appears on not-yet-fetched network readings: cloud is read from a network-drive mount, and network speed can't be metered per task.

u: /** 等数据时两排头像的占位，与路由骨架（`releasesFilterSkeleton`）同一份。 */
en: The placeholder of two rows of avatars while waiting for data, the same copy as the route skeleton (releasesFilterSkeleton).

u: /** 页码.Previous page／Next page在两端，页码居中，页数多时两侧折成「…」. */
en: Pagination. Previous page / Next page at the two ends, page numbers centered; when there are many pages, both sides collapse into '…'.

u: '清理文件名中的特殊符号与乱码，也可按模板改名并归入目录。先预览，确认后执行；执行过的一批可以整批退回。'
en: 'Clean special symbols and garbled characters from file names; you can also rename by template and file into folders. Preview first, then execute after confirming; an executed batch can be rolled back as a whole.'

u: // 共享进度的任务列表按不提供该接口的 Peach 应答，脚本退回逐页查询，不占用影片查询与提交的编号。
en: // The shared-progress task list follows the Peach response that doesn't provide that interface; the script falls back to page-by-page queries, not consuming the video query and submit numbers.

u: // 桩条目 3600 秒，10 秒一帧共 360 帧、4 张拼图。挂上之后再进详情，播放器挂载时取索引。
en: // The stub entry is 3600 seconds, one frame every 10 seconds, 360 frames total, 4 tile images. After mounting, entering detail, the player fetches the index on mount.

u: /* 这张卡上的结论只有一句: 跑着的那一趟、这次跟完的那一趟、刚出的Preview，按新旧取最新. */
en: The conclusion on this card is one line: the running trip, the trip just followed through this time, and the Preview just produced — take the newest by recency.

u: /** 一颗显示当前Source color的球；点开是「无颜色」加十二档Accent color. */
en: A ball showing the current Source color; tapping it opens 'No color' plus twelve Accent color levels.

u: /** 照输入框此刻的位置、内边距和字体摆一层空的覆盖层，字落在框里同一处；框不可见时是 null。 */
en: Lay an empty overlay following the input box's current position, padding, and font, so the text lands at the same spot in the box; it's null when the box is invisible.

u: '立即备份当前账本，或从列表里的一份备份恢复。恢复会替换当前账本，替换前先另存一份；只有写入端能恢复。'
en: 'Back up the current ledger now, or restore from a backup in the list. Restoring replaces the current ledger; a copy is saved first before replacing. Only the write side can restore.'

u: '将停止这一轮剩余的处理。已登记的影片、取得的资料和预览会保留。这一轮取消后不能继续，需要时重新同步。'
en: 'This will stop the remaining processing for this round. Already-registered videos, retrieved resources, and previews are preserved. This round cannot continue after cancellation; re-sync when needed.'

u: 'Mac 用 ⌃⌥⇧⌘ 字形按 Apple 次序连写，其余平台写 Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Win'
en: 'Mac uses the ⌃⌥⇧⌘ glyphs in Apple's order, written together; other platforms write Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Win'

u: /** 链接管理那张卡：四格读数（总数与三类链接）和三个主要站点等数据，键名同样画头一次的那一版。 */
en: That card in link management: a four-tile reading (total and three link types) plus data like the three main sites, and the key names are likewise rendered as the first version.

u: /** 写成一串给读屏与提示用：Mac 连写（`⇧S`），其余平台用加号连（`Shift+S`）。 */
en: Written as a single string for screen readers and tooltips: Mac writes it together (⇧S); other platforms join with a plus (Shift+S).

u: /* 壳换页时先中止上一趟、再登记这一趟，同一个任务里会先假后真；攒到微任务再读，这一下不算结束。 */
en: When the shell switches pages, it first aborts the previous trip, then registers this one; within the same task it's fake first, then real; batch until the microtask before reading, so this doesn't count as the end.

u: /* 来源视频Preview复用 Peach 控件；Playback状态只属于当前Preview. */
en: The source video Preview reuses Peach's controls; Playback status belongs only to the current Preview.

u: /* Video.js 10 浏览器模块按需从本地加载，All相对导入由 vendor 入口固定. */
en: Video.js 10's browser modules are loaded from local on demand; All relative imports are pinned by the vendor entry.

u: /* 与数据管理的问题清单同一种分层：名字一层，来源与问题类别跟在名字后面用次级色，原因再低一档。 */
en: The same hierarchy as the data management issue list: the name is one tier, source and issue category follow the name in a secondary color, and the reason is one tier lower.

u: /** 一条Pending merge的身份: 一个别名只可能归进一个规范名，所以用别名本身当键. */
en: The identity of a Pending merge entry: an alias can only map to one canonical name, so the alias itself is used as the key.

u: /** 新作分区的筛选与排序：都写在地址栏里，刷新与返回原样恢复。`seed` 只在换一批时有值。 */
en: The new-releases section's filter and sort: both written in the address bar, so refresh and back restore them as-is. seed only has a value when cycling to a new batch.

u: /* JAV 新作列表的列定义与本机列偏好的存放位置。不依赖 React：路由骨架与列表读同一份。 */
en: The column definitions for the JAV new-releases list and where local column preferences are stored. No React dependency: the route skeleton and the list read the same copy.

u: /** 一组「换一批」：在这一组取到的池里翻下一页，当场换，不发请求；再下一页的图顺手先拉进缓存。 */
en: A set of 'new batch': flip to the next page within the pool fetched for this group, swap on the spot, no request sent; the images for the page after that are pulled into cache in passing.

u: /** 空输入时的推荐栏，一次取齐（`/api/search/recommendations`）。 */
en: The recommendations bar for empty input, fetched in one go (/api/search/recommendations).

u: '按馆藏记录逐条查找本地磁盘与网盘上的文件，列出文件已不存在的记录、空文件夹，以及不再被引用的缓存。'
en: 'Look up files on local disks and network drives one by one per library record, listing records where the file no longer exists, empty folders, and cache no longer referenced.'

u: /** 一排键帽。`plus` 为真时键与键之间放加号（Windows 的写法），Mac 连写。 */
en: A row of key caps. When plus is true, put a plus sign between keys (the Windows convention); Mac writes them together.

u: /** 本机没有封面、来源也没给能代理的地址：服务端按番号重取官方封面，取到后详情换成本机那张。 */
en: No local cover and the source didn't give a proxy-able address: the server re-fetches the official cover by the code, and after it arrives, the detail swaps to the local one.

u: /** 一栏推荐：各组，以及还没聚焦时占位里轮换的推荐词（聚焦时另按当前筛选取 `pool`）。 */
en: A recommendations column: the groups, plus the recommendation words rotating in the placeholder before focus (on focus, pool is fetched separately by the current filter).

u: // 框线画成不占盒子的 outline：只比颜色会放过「有色无宽、根本没画出来」的线，宽度一起比。
en: // The border is drawn as an outline that doesn't occupy the box: comparing only color would let through a 'colored but zero-width, never actually drawn' line, so compare width too.

u: /* 首页标题跟着搜索词走：搜出来的这一屏是这个词的结果，不再是首页。清掉搜索词回到「首页」。 */
en: The home page title follows the search term: this screen of search results is the term's results, no longer the home page. Clearing the search term returns to 'Home'.

u: /** 传空恢复默认。存本机、不进同步设置，见 `keyboard-shortcut.ts`。 */
en: Passing empty restores the default. Stored locally, not included in sync settings; see keyboard-shortcut.ts.

u: /** 有一页还在取首屏：换页进度条（`navigation-progress.ts`）读它。 */
en: A page is still fetching its first screen: the page-switch progress bar (navigation-progress.ts) reads it.

u: /** 需要登录时紧跟在密码分区下面的设备列表；改密码后拿到新 `revision` 重新画。 */
en: The device list right below the password section when login is required; after changing the password, a new revision is fetched and redrawn.

u: /** `className` 换掉默认尺寸（独立图块 24px）；行内跟文字时传更小的尺寸。 */
en: className overrides the default size (standalone block 24px); when inline with text, pass a smaller size.

u: // 与 `../toaster.tsx` 的底边同一算法：默认边距、多选条、下角小窗取最高的那个。
en: // Same bottom-edge algorithm as ../toaster.tsx: the default margin, multi-select bar, and bottom-corner mini window take the tallest one.

u: /* 小窗、多选条与任务卡自己都把占位写在根节点的 style 上；回执进出看通知栈的子节点。 */
en: The mini window, multi-select bar, and task card each write their placeholder into the root node's style; receipts entering/leaving are tracked by the notification stack's child nodes.

u: /** 推荐栏一起带回的推荐词：还没聚焦、按筛选核过的 `pool` 还没取时，占位里轮换它。 */
en: Recommendation words returned together with the recommendations bar: before it's focused and the filter-verified pool hasn't been fetched yet, rotate these in the placeholder.

u: /* 滚轮与键盘共用的缓动目标：平移余量、目标比例（0 表示不缩放）和缩放不动点（视口坐标）。 */
en: The easing target shared by the wheel and keyboard: pan remainder, target scale (0 means no zoom), and the zoom fixed point (viewport coordinates).

u: // 停稳一小会儿才起翻（`use-stack-flip.ts` 的起步延时），一掠而过的指针不翻。
en: // It waits until steady for a moment before starting to flip (the start delay in use-stack-flip.ts); a pointer sweeping past doesn't flip.

u: // Mac 上 Option+S 打出来的是「ß」，记的仍是 KeyS；录好的那一组亮一下成功色。
en: // On Mac, Option+S types out 'ß', but what's recorded is still KeyS; the recorded set flashes a success color briefly.

u: // 每圈的底色扇区：路径头一段是 `M cx,cy-外径`，第二段弧是内径，取中间那条半径指上去。
en: // The base-color sector of each ring: the path's first segment is M cx,cy-outerRadius, the second arc is the inner radius, take the middle radius and point up to it.

u: 'SFW 快捷键按物理键位录制：只按修饰键还在等，缺修饰键说原因，按键不落到页面上，Esc 取消'
en: 'SFW shortcut is recorded by physical key position: pressing only a modifier key still waits, a missing modifier key explains why, the keypress doesn't land on the page, and Esc cancels'

u: /** 预览中心点：跟着指针，但整块留在进度条里，两端各让出 `inset`。放不下时居中。 */
en: Preview center point: follows the pointer, but the whole block stays within the progress bar, leaving inset on both ends. When it doesn't fit, it's centered.

u: /** StrictMode 的同步重取沿用Resources；最终卸载在微任务里统一清理. */
en: StrictMode's synchronous refetch reuses Resources; the final unmount is cleaned up uniformly in a microtask.

u: /** `installer` 是 macOS 的 DMG：没有应用内安装，下载后手动替换。 */
en: The installer is macOS's DMG: there's no in-app installation; after downloading, replace it manually.

u: /* 刚加上的标签按名字排进去，多半落在收起的那一截里，看着像没加上：收起时它们也露在外面。 */
en: Newly added tags are sorted in by name, mostly landing in the collapsed part, looking like they weren't added: when collapsed, they also show outside.

u: /** 一排五张净面读数卡：窄一档两张一排，手机上一张一排；数据管理首屏骨架用的也是这一串。 */
en: A row of five clean reading cards: one step narrower gives two per row, on phone one per row; the data management first-screen skeleton uses this same set.

u: /** Preview只列前 8 行: 这里是给人扫一眼方向对不对，完整计划在 CSV 里. */
en: The Preview only lists the first 8 rows: this is for a person to glance at whether the direction is right; the full plan is in the CSV.

u: /* 计数与预估之间的间距放进折叠区里层：写成外层的 gap，收起过渡走完那一刻会再跳一下。 */
en: The spacing between the count and the estimate goes into the inner layer of the collapse area: writing it as an outer gap makes it jump again at the moment the collapse transition finishes.

u: /** 备好的下一批先把封面和头像拉进浏览器缓存：换上去的那一刻图是现成的，不先空一下灰格。 */
en: The prepared next batch first pulls covers and avatars into the browser cache: the moment it swaps in, the images are ready, so there's no empty gray cell first.

u: /* 保存前先读一次扫描与采集的状态。单独接住它，各用例的 `fetch` 桩只数配置请求。 */
en: Before saving, read the scan and collection status once. Catch it separately, so each test case's fetch stub only counts config requests.

u: `头像与署名拆成作品列之后单独的艺人列：${JSON.stringify(geometry)}`

u: // 拉丁字母、数字相邻处多出间距，量宽时要算上，否则判成「放得下」的结果实际溢出、末尾被裁掉。
en: // Latin letters and digits add extra spacing at their junctions; measure that into the width, or the result judged as 'fits' actually overflows and the end gets clipped.

u: // Driver 在 onPopoverRender 之后创建遮罩；下一帧把它也移入原生弹层。
en: // Driver creates the overlay after onPopoverRender; the next frame also moves it into the native popover.

u: // 每个媒体库取它的第一行作代表: 新加的空Folders排在后面，不改动这一库的图标与来源.
en: // For each media library, take its first row as the representative: newly added empty Folders go to the back, without changing this library's icon and source.

u: /* Resources查询按作品发行日缓存；浏览器重启后也可读取，最多保留 128 部. */
en: The Resources query is cached by the work's release date; it can also be read after a browser restart, keeping up to 128 works.

u: /** 页头筛选框是名册页那个 `IndexSearch`：停手 300 毫秒才交出文字。 */
en: The page header filter box is the roster page's IndexSearch: it waits 300 ms of idle before emitting text.

u: /** GET 回列表，POST 按地址回给定的状态；记下每一次 POST 的地址与正文。 */
en: GET returns the list, POST returns the given status by address; record each POST's address and body.

u: // 收起后等页面空闲才去备下一批，不跟紧接着的打开详情抢请求；再打开时那批还在路上，栏里照旧，
en: // After collapsing, wait for the page to idle before preparing the next batch, so it doesn't compete with the immediately-following detail-open for requests; when reopened, that batch is still in transit, the column stays as is,

u: 已取得的资料和预览已保留，这一轮不会自动继续，需要时重新同步。
en: The retrieved resources and previews are preserved; this round will not continue automatically; re-sync when needed.

u: 'JAV 新作分区骨架按下新作，页头是名册页那种筛选框，下面是两排头像占位与新作自己的排序键'

u: /** 自有接触印相按页预热的上限：两小时的片子 10 秒一帧是 8 张，再长的按需取。 */
en: The upper limit of page-based preheating for own touch frames: a two-hour video at one frame per 10 seconds is 8 frames; anything longer is fetched on demand.

u: /* 结束原因是这一轮的结论，和摘要一样写在正文里；全文是明细，收进下面的「错误详情」。 */
en: The end reason is the conclusion of this round, written in the body like the summary; the full text is details, collapsed into 'Error details' below.

u: // 搜索记录排在左栏最下面：它比推荐晚到，排在末尾到了也不把上面的往下推。键盘上下按画出来的
en: // Search records go at the very bottom of the left column: they arrive later than recommendations, and arriving at the end doesn't push the content above down. Keyboard up/down follow what's drawn

u: // 一轮结束：成功的回执走 Toast，失败的原因留在分区里。只报这一页上看着开始的那一轮。
en: // A round ends: successful receipts go through a Toast, failure reasons stay in the section. Only report the round that appears to have started on this page.

u: /** 媒体库在下拉里的图标: 选过就用选的，否则按来源自动识别，和标题行的图标键一致. */
en: The media library's icon in the dropdown: use the selected one if chosen, otherwise auto-identify by source, consistent with the title row's icon key.

u: /* 「网络与访问」分组：本机端口、Peach 代理、访问密码与已登录的设备、公网入口。 */
en: 'Network and access' group: local port, Peach proxy, access password and logged-in devices, public entry point.

u: /* 保留 kept 个字形时的显示文字，奇数位优先保留开头；kept 等于总数即原文。 */
en: The display text when keeping kept glyphs, odd positions prefer keeping the start; when kept equals the total, it's the original text.

u: // 失败卡的框线要有宽度才画得出来，且画成不占盒子的 outline，不把内容挤进 1px。
en: // The failure card's border needs a width to be drawn, and it's drawn as an outline that doesn't occupy the box, so content isn't squeezed into 1px.

u: '进度条画面预览：按时刻取格、靠边整块留在进度条里、每页拼图只取一次；小窗与触屏拖动同一块'

u: /* 列的先后照 `catalogColumns`，与骨架、「显示列」里的顺序同一份。 */
en: The column order follows catalogColumns, the same as the skeleton and the 'display columns' order.

u: /* First-time setup与配置页共用的选择Fields和固定前后缀输入. */
en: The selection Fields and fixed prefix/suffix input shared between First-time setup and the config page.

u: /* 取消不止是眼前点的那一下：命令行、任务中心取消的、重开页面才读到的，都留这一句。 */
en: Cancellation isn't just the click right in front of you: those from the command line, the task center, and ones only read after reopening the page all leave this one line.

u: // 订阅Source color样式表: 改色时卡片当场试色，Save后服务端的颜色接替.
en: // Subscribe to the Source color stylesheet: when changing colors, the card previews them live, and the server's colors take over after Save.

u: /** 镜头每帧只写世界层；视口快走出已渲染的磁贴范围时才发布一次 React 状态。 */
en: The camera only writes to the world layer each frame; React state is published only once when the viewport is about to leave the rendered tile range.

u: /* 二分寻找能放下的最长首尾组合，返回保留的字形数；全都放不下时为 0，只剩省略号。 */
en: Binary search for the longest head-tail combination that fits, returning the number of glyphs kept; when nothing fits, it's 0, leaving only the ellipsis.
